# Security: Crypto Hunt

The threat model follows STRIDE over every trust boundary in [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md#trust-boundaries).

## Assets and threats

| Asset | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| Answer key (`questions.answer`) | Leaking it skips the riddles |
| QR tokens, secret keys, assignments, location clues | Leaking them lets a team skip rounds or go straight to the final |
| Completion order and times | Decide elimination and the podium |
| Completion keys | Prove a win |
| Admin powers | Can change any outcome |
| Player names | Personal data (minimal) |
| Service-role key | Full DB access |

| # | Threat (STRIDE) | Abuse case | Mitigation | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| T1 | Information disclosure | A player reads `questions`, `qr_codes`, `assignments`, `locations` through the anon key | No select policies for players; RPCs return only the caller's own question text, own pieces and own region | Integration: as a player, each table returns 0 rows; no response contains `answer`, `key`, `token` |
| T2 | Spoofing | A normal camera app or an outsider scans a QR | `/q/[token]` has no side effects; `scan_qr` needs an authenticated active player in a RUNNING game | Integration: anonymous → NOT_AUTHENTICATED |
| T3 | Tampering | A team uses a photo of another team's QR + key | QRs valid only for assigned teams; key bound to the QR | Integration: other team → NOT_YOURS |
| T4 | Tampering | Skipping ahead with a later-round QR: found by chance, photographed, or its printed key noted down for later (D-025) | Round lock: `scan_qr` returns `LOCKED_MARK` with no clue, question, map or ticket; `submit_key` needs a scan ticket that only exists for the team's own current-round QR; early scans are never stored; same response for own-path and other QRs; alert per try, `possible_sweep` at 3 per round | Integration: R1 team scans R3 own + other → identical LOCKED_MARK, no ticket; `submit_key` with the correct R3 key → LOCKED_MARK; later in R3 the earlier scan doesn't count |
| T20 | Elevation of privilege | A client calls an internal helper (`_complete_round`, `_eliminate`, …) or a join function directly | Supabase's default privileges grant EXECUTE to `anon`/`authenticated` on new functions. Migration 0007 revokes all and grants exactly the API; default privileges for `postgres` locked | Integration: helpers and join functions → permission denied for players and anonymous callers |
| T19 | Tampering | Reaching the final QR early and reading its printed key, or sharing it with other teams | Final check-in also needs the team's own seal code (D-026), created only when the final clue is solved, returned only to that team; plus the round lock | Integration: final key without code → BAD_SEAL; other team's code → BAD_SEAL + alert; code absent before the final round |
| T5 | Tampering | Guessing QR tokens or keys | 24-byte random tokens; 6-char keys (~1 billion) + 5/min rate limit + alert; constant-time compare | Integration: 6th key try in a minute → RATE_LIMITED |
| T6 | Tampering | Brute-forcing answers | 10 answers/min/player, alert on hitting the limit; MCQ wrong attempts visible to admin | Integration: 11th answer → RATE_LIMITED |
| T7 | Tampering | One member checks in for all four | Check-in is per authenticated player; each needs their own scan + key; one session per player | Integration: same user twice → counted once |
| T8 | Tampering | Faking times or skipping the hint penalty | All times from `now()`; `complete_round` checks `now() ≥ penalty_until`; pause extends `penalty_until` | Integration: early complete → PENALTY_RUNNING |
| T9 | Tampering / race | Two teams complete the X-th slot together | Row lock on `rounds[r]`; unique `(round_id, completion_order)` | Simulation: exactly X complete each round |
| T10 | Elevation of privilege | A player calls admin RPCs or writes tables | `is_admin()` in every admin RPC; admin-only RLS on writes | Integration: each admin RPC as player → NOT_ADMIN |
| T11 | Spoofing | Someone with a leaked team code joins or takes over a member | Team locks at 4; name+code takeover raises an admin alert; admin can kick | Integration: 5th join → TEAM_FULL; takeover → alert row |
| T12 | Tampering | Forged `apply_game_plan` (e.g., a team assigned straight to the final) | Plan re-validated in SQL: counts, links, one path per team, round order; only the admin can call it; secrets generated server-side | Integration: invalid plans rejected |
| T13 | Repudiation | Disputed elimination or override | Every override needs a reason → `admin_audit`; `events` timeline with server timestamps | Integration: override creates an audit row |
| T14 | Denial of service | Spamming scans, focus events, joins | Per-player rate limits; focus events capped at 50 per task; join rate limit per IP in the Edge Function | Integration |
| T15 | XSS | A name or broadcast with `<script>` | React escaping; name validator; no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` (lint rule); CSP | Unit |
| T16 | Information disclosure | Secrets in the client bundle or repo | Only `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` reach the client; `server-only`; `.env*` ignored; service role only in Supabase | `scripts/check-bundle-secrets.mjs` after build |
| T17 | Information disclosure | The print sheet leaks | `/admin/print` admin-only; keys shown nowhere else | Integration |
| T18 | Cheating (out of band) | Googling answers, a second phone | Leave-site warning + admin alert (D-017). **A second device can't be detected.** Accepted | Unit: focus guard fires |

## Authentication and authorization

- **Players:** accounts created by the `player-join` Edge Function (D-005): synthetic email, random password nobody sees, pre-confirmed, no email sent. The phone signs in with a one-time login token and claims the player's session with a single-use nonce. One active session per player: a new join with the same name moves it and the old phone gets `SESSION_MOVED`.
- **Admin:** admin name + passcode → Supabase Auth (synthetic email). `admins` table membership = `is_admin()`. Passcode ≥ 10 chars.
- **Authorization:** RLS on every table; all game writes through security-definer RPCs with `search_path` pinned.

## Secrets

- Service-role key only inside Supabase (Edge Function env) and local `.env.local` for the test project.
- QR tokens/keys generated with `gen_random_bytes` in SQL.

## Data protection

- Only names are stored. Everything is deleted on New Game (after optional export).

## Third parties

- None at runtime besides Supabase and Vercel.

## Security tests

- `integration/security.test.ts`, `integration/game.test.ts`, `integration/join.test.ts` — negative and full-game tests against the test project (`npm run test:integration`).
- `scripts/check-bundle-secrets.mjs` — post-build scan.
- Bot simulation re-checks T3, T4, T7, T9, T19 on every step (bots scan later-round QRs and try their keys on purpose).
